prior_evidence.e3_finding: Distinct observer methods can be held outside the current CellUptakeReceipt canonical payload and therefore collide at receipt digest scope.

multi_receipt_assignment_swap.finding: A summary-level unordered observer set cannot preserve which observer produced which cell receipt; leaf binding does.

instrumentation_scope.observed_pattern: Telemetry is associated with a typed instrumentation scope identified by name/version/schema_url/attributes so the emitting instrumentation unit is distinguishable.

resource_boundary.observed_pattern: The observed entity and the instrumentation agent that technically emits telemetry are distinct concepts; observer identity should not be conflated with the observed workload identity.

supported: If WP507 wants future higher-scope measurement provenance, the smallest identity-preserving placement is a typed immutable observer/evidence-producer binding referenced by digest from each CellUptakeReceipt.
The binding must remain evidence metadata only; it cannot mint truth, causal credit, effect authority or runtime acceptance by itself.

UptakeSummary can inherit observer identity transitively through source_receipt_sha256s; CausalInfluenceResult can inherit it through uptake_summary_sha256 without duplicating the full binding at every layer.
A per-receipt digest field is cheaper than embedding the full example binding in every receipt: 93 serialized bytes versus 380 bytes for the example typed object in this fixture.
not_supported: No claim that current WP507 produced a false real-world causal result.
No target-runtime, physical GRID10, GWT runtime, J-Space, model, training, effect, completion or whole-system credit.
No recommendation to import OpenTelemetry or another observability stack as a project dependency.
